title: Subscription billing portal
problem: customers could not upgrade, downgrade or update cards without emailing support
approach: built a self-serve billing area with proration, invoices and dunning emails
results: billing support tickets down by two thirds

title: Two-sided services marketplace MVP
problem: a founder needed an MVP to test demand before raising money
approach: built search, booking, reviews and live chat between customers and providers

title: Custom CRM with task automation
problem: agents tracked leads in shared spreadsheets and missed follow-ups
approach: built lead pipelines, automatic reminders and email sequences
results: agents saved about 6 hours a week each

title: Headless Shopify storefront
problem: the theme-based store was slow on mobile
approach: rebuilt the storefront on the Storefront API with server rendering and image optimisation

title: Real-time support chat widget
problem: the client paid for a third-party chat tool that did not fit their product
approach: built an embeddable widget, agent console and message persistence
results: handled 3,000 concurrent connections in load tests

title: Clinic appointment booking system
problem: patients booked by phone and many forgot appointments
approach: built online booking with calendar sync and SMS reminders

title: Internal admin dashboard for a logistics firm
problem: operations staff switched between four spreadsheets to find an order
approach: built a searchable admin with order timelines and bulk actions
results: order lookup from about 3 minutes to 10 seconds

title: WordPress to Next.js migration
problem: a publisher's WordPress site was slow and hard to change
approach: kept WordPress as the editor and moved the front end to Next.js with redirects for every old URL
results: page load from 4.2 s to 1.1 s
organic traffic held steady through the migration

title: Offline-first PWA for field inspectors
problem: inspectors lost forms when sites had no signal
approach: built an installable app that stores inspections locally and syncs when back online
results: inspections captured offline at 40 remote sites

title: Public REST API with rate limiting
problem: partners integrated through CSV files emailed every night
approach: designed a versioned API with keys, quotas and generated documentation

title: End-to-end test suite and CI pipeline
problem: releases regularly broke the checkout flow
approach: wrote critical-path browser tests and gated merges on them
results: release regressions down from about 5 to 1 per quarter

title: Habit-tracking app on Supabase
problem: a solo founder wanted a production-ready app without managing servers
approach: built auth, streaks, reminders and an admin view on Supabase

title: Learning platform with video courses
problem: a training company sold courses through a clunky plugin
approach: built course pages, progress tracking, quizzes and certificates

title: Containerised deployment on AWS
problem: deploys were manual and took most of an afternoon
approach: containerised the app, wrote infrastructure as code and automated blue-green deploys

title: Payouts for a tutoring marketplace
problem: tutors were paid manually by bank transfer each Friday
approach: built onboarding, split payments and automatic payouts with reconciliation
results: payout day moved from weekly to daily

title: Conversion-focused landing pages
problem: paid campaigns sent traffic to a generic homepage
approach: built fast, focused pages per campaign with variant testing
results: pages load in under a second

title: GraphQL API for a recipe app
problem: the mobile app made dozens of calls per screen
approach: designed a GraphQL schema with batched resolvers
results: removed N+1 queries; p95 from 900 ms to 160 ms
app screens load in one round trip

title: SSO and OAuth integration
problem: enterprise prospects required single sign-on before signing
approach: added SSO, just-in-time provisioning and audit logs
